description: This file defines the PersistableCustomer class, which extends CustomerEntity and implements Serializable. It manages a list of customer attributes and provides getter and setter methods for that list.

classes.name: PersistableCustomer
classes.description: A class representing a customer object that can be persisted, with attributes stored as a list of PersistableCustomerAttribute objects.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of customer attributes.
